domain.description: Business domain, e.g. 'E-commerce checkout', 'HR leave management'

suite.description: node-test: glob patterns for the full suite

smoke.description: node-test: patterns; command: test files passed as {files}

command.description: command runner: shell command. Placeholders for the selected test files (empty for the whole suite): {files} (quoted paths), {classes} (class names, comma-separated), {class-args:FLAG} (FLAG Class for each), {filter} (dotnet test filter), {packages} (Go-style folders), {names}. {?...} keeps its content only when files are selected, e.g. mvn -B test{? -Dtest={classes}}

junitReport.description: command runner: test report relative to the repo root: a file, a folder (every .xml/.trx in it) or a glob such as target/surefire-reports/*.xml. JUnit XML, .NET TRX and NUnit 3 XML are read

workdir.description: Subfolder the stack lives in, e.g. backend; commands run there. Omit for the repository root

toolchain.description: Language versions the project needs, e.g. { "java": "17" }; checked against the platform image (REQ-027)

regressionTest.description: Path for generated regression tests. {ticketId} = TKT-1042, {TicketId} = Tkt1042 (valid class name), {ticket_id} = tkt_1042; e.g. test/regression/{ticketId}.test.js, src/test/java/regression/{TicketId}RegressionTest.java

setup.description: Installs dependencies in a fresh checkout before its first test run, e.g. npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund

affectedCommand.description: Runs only the tests affected by the changed files ({files}), e.g. npx vitest related --run --passWithNoTests ... {files}. Small, low-risk fixes use it before review; the full suite then runs after the merge

dependencyDirs.description: Folders the setup produces that every fix checkout with the same lockfiles can share from a cache (default for npm, pnpm and yarn: ["node_modules"]; [] turns caching off)

timeoutMs.description: Limit per test run in ms (default 30 min for the command runner, 2 min for node-test); a run over the limit is stopped and fails

staticCheck.description: 'builtin' (JS/JSON syntax), 'none', or a shell command run in the worktree

database.description: REQ-025: where the application keeps its database migrations. A fix may add migrations here (never change applied ones); the application's own pipeline applies them on deploy.

migrations.description: Folders holding migration files, e.g. prisma/migrations/, src/main/resources/db/migration/

schema.description: Files describing the current schema that change with each migration, e.g. prisma/schema.prisma or an EF Core model snapshot

tool.description: For display: prisma, flyway, liquibase, ef-core, alembic, rails, knex, sequelize or sql

engine.description: REQ-026: the database engine. With postgres and SQL migrations (prisma, flyway, sql) the AI and the checks use a throwaway PostgreSQL built from the migrations; no database is connected to

url.description: Base URL of the environment (passed to smoke commands as ADLC_ENV_URL)

versionUrl.description: Endpoint returning JSON with the deployed commit, used for verification

command.description: Run in the deployed release folder; {state} = the environment's ops-state file
